name: values_per_line
note: product.template.attribute.line.value_ids many2many owner (addons/product/models/product_template_attribute_line.py:32): values per attribute line with the lowest value id, as the configurator reads them
source_sql: SELECT product_template_attribute_line_id AS line_id, count(*) AS values, min(product_attribute_value_id) AS first_value FROM product_attribute_value_product_template_attribute_line_rel GROUP BY product_template_attribute_line_id ORDER BY product_template_attribute_line_id

name: lines_per_value
note: product.attribute.value.pav_attribute_line_ids inverse side (addons/product/models/product_attribute_value.py:29): attribute lines per value, the count behind a value's template usage
source_sql: SELECT product_attribute_value_id AS value_id, count(*) AS lines FROM product_attribute_value_product_template_attribute_line_rel GROUP BY product_attribute_value_id ORDER BY product_attribute_value_id
